name: Archmage Malin
summary: Outside the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, Archmage Malin directs arcane affairs. A former pupil of Archmage Trelane, he coordinates field agents seeking magical artifacts and rare reagents across the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Watcher of the Wizard's Sanctum
sections.body: Archmage Malin is the central contact for Stormwind's arcane practitioners, stationed beneath the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter. He learned magic under Archmage Trelane, and now works to protect the scattered legacy of his former master. While acolytes study inside the tower, Malin watches over matters across the realm that need magical oversight.

sections.title: Eyes in the Highlands
sections.body: Archmage Malin directs much of his attention north, to the perilous ruins of the Arathi Highlands. He sent his trusted associates, Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten, to recover Archmage Trelane's lost possessions and secure delicate spell components. From the capital, Malin coordinates their work and relies on capable Alliance travelers to carry instructions, supplies, and intelligence to his agents in hostile territory.

faq.answer: Archmage Malin is a high-ranking human mage in Stormwind City. Outside the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter, he oversees research, dispatches field apprentices, and helps maintain order among the capital's magical practitioners.

faq.q: What is Malin's connection to Archmage Trelane?
faq.answer: Archmage Trelane was Archmage Malin's master and mentor. Malin remains deeply loyal to Trelane and coordinates efforts to find and recover his former master's belongings and magical relics in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why does Malin send adventurers to the Arathi Highlands?
faq.answer: Archmage Malin sends travelers to reach his agents, Skuerto and Apprentice Kryten, in the Arathi Highlands. The journey is dangerous and communication is difficult, so he needs them to carry requests, magical supplies, and instructions for recovering Trelane's artifacts.

faq.q: Where can Archmage Malin be found?
faq.answer: Archmage Malin stands outside the Wizard's Sanctum entrance at the tower's base, in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter. From there, he overlooks the ramps leading up to the sanctum's portal chamber.

angles.text: As an Alliance mage visiting the Wizard's Sanctum, you see Malin connect formal study in Stormwind with the hazards of recovering lost relics in the wild.
As an Alliance traveler, you know Malin's operatives in Arathi seek powerful artifacts before they fall into the hands of the Syndicate, the Boulderfist ogres, or the Horde.
